bibl.title: Definitions and Technical Terminology in the Erôtapokriseis on Papyrus.
bibl.seg: Isabella Bonati, Definitions and Technical Terminology in the Erôtapokriseis on Papyrus.
Michiel Meeusen (ed.), Ancient Greek Medicine in Questions and Answers. Diagnostics, Didactics, Dialectics (Leiden - Boston, 2020) pp. 154-180.
bibl.note: Analyses some specific aspects of catechisms on papyrus mainly devoted to individual diseases, by focusing more precisely on the definition of the pathology and the technical terminology employed to express it.
